hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Any extension of an already unique subarray is itself unconditionally unique.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Monotonicity allows binary search over candidate subarray lengths from 1 to n.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Rolling hash or tuple indexing checks if any candidate window of length mid appears exactly once.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search on length combined with linear window frequency counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) subarrays with pairwise comparisons is cubic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retains window tokens in frequency mapping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Establishes monotonicity and binary searches for the minimal unique length.
